dhp309:1: _Pamatta_ can also mean “intoxicated” or “infatuated” (as well as “negligent”).
dhp309:3: _Apuññalābha_ (lit. “one gains non-merit”), _na nikāmaseyya_ (lit. “one cannot sleep when one wishes to”)
dhp310:3: The “king” mentioned here may refer literally to governmental punishment for adultery (which has usually been a serious crime throughout most of human history), or it may refer to Yāma, the so-called “king of death” (see MN130), and the “punishment” therefore is rebirth in hell as a consequence of immoral behavior.
